map.用时 = (当前时间戳 − 开始时间戳) ÷ 1000（秒）；WPM = 用时: Elapsed = (current timestamp − start timestamp) ÷ 1000 (seconds); WPM = elapsed > 0 ? round((correct keystrokes ÷ 5) ÷ (elapsed ÷ 60)) : 0 (correct keystrokes count only newly added characters, not repeated); accuracy = total keystrokes > 0 ? round(correct keystrokes ÷ total keystrokes × 100) : 0; reset clears the timer, disables and empties the input, and sets elapsed to 0 s, WPM to 0, accuracy to 0%; 5 target sentences in total
